description: rug check, smart contract security, who controls this contract before an agent approves, deposits into or calls it: Use for a verdict and a 0-100 score before approving, depositing or calling, or for a past block. For facts without a score use pacta_who_controls_contract. One-call pre-execution safety check of a contract before an agent interacts with it: verdict (no controller found / timelock / zero-delay timelock / multisig / EOA admin / unclassified / undeployed) with the checks run, 0-100 risk score (null when not determined: no contract, or NO_CONTROLLER_FOUND), proxy + implementation, controller kind, zero-delay upgradeability and pause / blacklist / upgrade capabilities, pinned to a block. Free: 50 calls per caller per UTC day (no key), then $0.01 USDC via HTTP GET /v1/check/preflight.

block.description: Block to pin: "latest" (default), a decimal block number or 0x-hex
